text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Yukino Bijin!
To be honest, I thought you wouldn't be able to run at all.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Well, but come to think of it, she ran in
the Oka Sho and the Oaks. She definitely has real skill~

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijiiin!
Keep doing your best!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: You got a huge round of applause out there.
You got so much applause, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
everyone was so warm and kind.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, long as I can deliver proper results, everything'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...I think I was able to run
real proud and mighty today!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes! Maybe it's because you helped take the pressure off my shoulders, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: All that unnecessary tension was gone, and I felt like I could really run like myself.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I think... I might actually kinda like
the way I am today."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: Keep that momentum going for the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
—Yukino-chan really was cute.
With looks like that, nothing's gonna stop her momentum.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, a new plushie just came out,
right? I've gotta buy one!"

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! Should we take that and go on an expedition?
Gotta ride the trend while it's hot, after all—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "I'm definitely gonna get results at the Shuka Sho...!"
